section_summary.extract_value: This results section describes a single study (Study X) of 326 middle-aged Saudi women examining the relationship between body mass index (BMI), body appreciation (BA), and weight loss (WL) intentions. The study found that women's body appreciation was significantly negatively correlated with BMI (r=-0.237, p<0.01), and mediation analysis revealed that body appreciation fully mediated the relationship between BMI and weight loss intentions. Demographic characteristics included a mean age of 49.14 years, mean BMI of 29.64 kg/m², and 66.6% with education above secondary school level.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a single study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women. The sample had a mean age of 49.14 years, with 33.4% having college or higher education and a mean BMI of 29.64 kg/m². Body appreciation was significantly negatively correlated with BMI (r=-0.237, p<0.01), and mediation analysis revealed that body appreciation fully mediated the relationship between BMI and weight loss intentions.
